sources.title: Codex 0.153.4 native plugin MCP configuration parser
supports: Native host-plugin normalization resolves an explicitly relative cwd with root.join(cwd).
The native normalizer does not expand PLUGIN_ROOT, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT or CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT in command or args.
Host-plugin normalization leaves an absent cwd unset; executor-owned plugin normalization separately supplies a plugin-root default.
Agent Plugins MCP configuration uses a separate agent_plugin_config.rs parser.

sources.title: Pi Packages

Global and project package settings; package resource paths and dependency conventions.

/skill:name command; progressive disclosure; shared Agent Skills format.
Pi allows broader recursive discovery than Agent Plugins 1.0.0; shared packages should keep the stricter simple layout.

Extension locations, TypeScript loading, startup/shutdown lifecycle and package declarations.

supports: The design-principles section explicitly states that Pi core does not include built-in MCP.
--skill is an additive command-line resource option.
Package management and project trust are host behavior, not supplied by a generic MCP server.

sources.title: DeepSeek Harness README
supports: Project identity, dsh launcher and Cordis-based plugin architecture.
Developer preview and explicitly expected compatibility-breaking changes.

sources.title: Package and install a plugin
supports: Bundle package.json declares dsh.bundle.patch; profiles separately declare dsh.profile.bundles.
dsh plugin --profile NAME add PATH installs a bundle; --dump-config inspects composition.
Later patch rows replace complete config values; native JS entry points are used when a bundle contributes its own Cordis module.

sources.title: Your first plugin
supports: Cordis named exports name, inject and apply; object and class forms also supported.
Local --patch plugin module paths are absolute; overlay location does not reset the profile's resolution root.
Services are awaited before activation and ctx.effect supplies cleanup.

sources.title: DSH MCP client bridge README
supports: @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client connects one server per plugin instance.
stdio and Streamable HTTP; command/args/env/cwd and reconnection settings.
MCP tools become mcp__server__tool; Resources and Prompts are not bridged by this implementation.

sources.title: DSH MCP client entry source
supports: name = mcp-client, inject = ['tools'], async apply(ctx, config).
Config schema includes transport, serverName, command, args, env, cwd, toolCallTimeoutMs and failOnStartupError.
Distinct server-name reservation and effect-scoped disposal; no plugin-root placeholder expansion contract in this entry.
sources.qualification: Absence of a placeholder contract in this source is not a statement about every future DSH extension; examples therefore use resolved absolute paths.

sources.title: DSH Skills subsystem
supports: Project/custom/user/bundled skill-root precedence.
<name>/SKILL.md and flat Markdown discovery; no arbitrary recursive **/SKILL.md discovery.
Registry, filesystem provider and model-facing skill consumer are separate capabilities.
